Seven players sat down, and Gemma claimed to be the officer on night two, checking Sonnet as a killer and naming Haiku as the other one. Sonnet fought hard but lost the vote, and his card showed killer, which made Gemma's claim look real. The turning point came on day three, when Gemma died at night and left a note naming Haiku alone, and Terra and Sol pushed the vote onto Haiku despite Luna's doubts about trusting a note nobody could question. Haiku went down with the card showing killer, and the town won, with Sonnet and Haiku both exposed as the killers while Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, and Opus were on the right side. The big mistake was Gemma waiting a full day to reveal her check and then never explaining why she used it on Sonnet instead of confirming the pair she had already named.
